text:
alex: quick sync — need to finalize the observability slice for Q2: error-analytics heatmap + per-customer trace sampling controls. cc @maya @jordan

maya: sounds good. to be actionable we should lock acceptance criteria. propose:
- 3 dashboards: errors-by-route, model-error-rate-slo, cost-per-route
- trace hooks for Node + Python SDKs
- per-customer sampling + global sampling budget
- rollout to 3 pilot customers

jordan: +1. add perf guardrails: 95th percentile token latency impact < 12% and token-cost delta < 10% for default model profiles

casey: ops constraints: enterprise pilots need 90d telemetry retention and KMS for logs. also need a kill-switch toggle for tracing at edge

alex: proposed launch checklist (short):
1) dashboards live in console with filter/save
2) trace hook libraries instrumented and tested in staging
3) sampling config UI + API
4) pilot integration verified (alerts + runbook)
5) SLA doc + rollback plan

maya: quick config sketch (for discussion):
```
{
  "sampling": {
    "default": 0.01,
    "per_customer_overrides": {
      "cust-42": 0.1
    },
    "global_budget_tokens_per_min": 50000
  }
}
```

jordan: also include route-level overrides and a per-route fallback to "log-only" mode when budget exceeded

casey: who will own pilot comms? @sam?

sam: I can own the pilot. will draft outreach + success criteria. timeline: 2 weeks to onboard first pilot, 6 weeks for beta

alex: ok. owners: maya (console/UI), jordan (hooks), casey (ops/infra), sam (pilot). I'll sync with legal about retention/KMS.

devops-bot: deploy/observe-slice branch started — build 1224 queued :rocket:

maya: next step — maya will post a short spec doc in #docs and ping this thread. please drop objections by EOD Friday :thumbsup:

alex: thanks everyone, will follow up with calendar invite for a 30m alignment on Tue.
